outcomes.text: Understand short recordings about everyday needs, such as shopping transactions, directions and instructions.
Understand factual information and ideas from various sources about familiar topics.
Understand descriptions of events, opinions, emotions, hopes and ambitions in simple spoken texts.
Identify main points, specific information and details in recordings about everyday topics.
Identify main points, themes, opinions, ideas, emotions and attitudes in predictable spoken texts.
Infer the meaning of occasional unfamiliar words and expressions from context.
Understand short, simple written texts.
Understand authentic texts about familiar topics and situations.
Understand descriptions of events, opinions, emotions, hopes and ambitions in simple texts.
Identify main points, specific information and details in predictable texts.
Identify main points, themes, opinions, ideas, emotions and attitudes in predictable texts.
Infer the meaning of occasional unfamiliar words and expressions from context.
Take part in short social exchanges and communicate about familiar topics to meet simple needs.
Participate in spontaneous conversations about familiar personal or everyday topics.
Describe past events and experiences, hopes and ambitions, and briefly justify opinions and plans.
Communicate with reasonable accuracy using varied structures, tenses and relevant vocabulary.
Use simple connectors to link shorter points into a connected sequence.
Use suitable strategies to keep an interaction going.
Use pronunciation and intonation features to communicate meaning and attitude.
Complete forms with simple personal details.
Communicate simple factual information in writing using everyday vocabulary and expressions.
Write linked simple phrases and sentences about personal life, surroundings and everyday topics.
Write simple connected texts about familiar topics.
Describe past events and experiences, opinions, hopes and ambitions, briefly explaining opinions and plans.
Communicate with reasonable accuracy using varied structures, time frames and relevant vocabulary.
Use simple connectors to link shorter points into a connected sequence.
Use definite and indefinite articles accurately.
Use singular, plural, possessive, countable, uncountable, compound and derived noun forms.
Use comparative, superlative, possessive, demonstrative, quantitative and compound adjective forms.
Use adverbs expressing time, place, manner, frequency, degree, direction, sequence, comparison and superlative meaning.
Use personal, possessive, reflexive, demonstrative, quantitative, indefinite, relative and impersonal pronouns.
Use regular and irregular verbs in appropriate persons, numbers, tenses and forms.
Use infinitives, gerunds, passives, phrasal verbs, dependent prepositions, causatives and related verb patterns.
Use modal verbs to express ability, possibility, permission, requests, offers, advice, obligation, prohibition and necessity.
Use zero, first and second conditional forms.
Report statements, commands and questions accurately.
Use coordinating and subordinating conjunctions to connect ideas.
Use prepositions and prepositional phrases for place, time, direction, method and other relationships.
Use cardinal and ordinal numbers, quantities, dates, times and years.
Use vocabulary relating to time expressions, including times, days, months and seasons.
Use vocabulary relating to food and drink, including meals, ingredients, snacks, beverages and utensils.
Use vocabulary relating to the human body, health and illness.
Use vocabulary relating to travel and transport.
Know and use vocabulary for travel and transport, including adventures, vehicles, baggage, journeys, directions, tickets, tourists, stations and transport services.
Know and use expressions for arriving, getting lost, crossing roads, departing, driving, flying, boarding, hiking, parking, travelling and walking.
Understand and use expressions for sequence, dates, durations, frequency, relative time and annual periods.
Understand and use vocabulary for telling the time and describing parts of the day.
Recognise and use the names of the days of the week.
Recognise and use the names of the months.
Recognise and use vocabulary for the four seasons.
Understand and use vocabulary for meals and meal courses.
Understand and use vocabulary for common fruits and vegetables.
Know and use words for common fruit and vegetables, including orange, peach, pear, pepper, pineapple, plum, potato, raspberry, strawberry, tomato and watermelon.
Know and use vocabulary for meat, fish and seafood, including beef, chicken, fish, ham, lamb, pork, sausage and steak.
Know and use words for snacks and snack foods, including burgers, chips, chocolate, crisps, ice cream, pizza and sweets.
Know and use vocabulary for drinks, including coffee, cola, juice, lemonade, milk, mineral water, soft drinks, tea and water types.
Know and use words for tableware and eating utensils, including bowls, chopsticks, cups, forks, glasses, knives, mugs, pans and plates.
Know and use words for additional tableware, including pots, saucers and spoons.
Know and use expressions about eating and drinking, hunger, thirst, dieting, barbecues, meals, food preparation and serving.
Know and use adjectives describing food, including cooked, fresh, raw, spicy and sweet.
Know and use vocabulary for body parts, including ankles, arms, backs, beards, bones, chests, ears, eyes, faces, fingers, feet, heads, hearts, knees and legs.
Know and use vocabulary for further body parts and features, including moustaches, mouths, necks, noses, shoulders, skin, stomachs, throats, toes, teeth and voices.
Know and use expressions for breathing, seeing, smelling, touching, baldness and wearing glasses.
Know and use vocabulary for healthcare and illness, including appointments, dentists, doctors, medicines, nurses, pharmacies and plasters.
Know and use expressions about health, illness, tiredness, injuries, exercise, falls, recovery, symptoms, colds, fevers, headaches, allergies and pain.
Know and use expressions for improving or worsening health, going to the gym, having illnesses, lying down and travelling.
